title: app-02: Split render.rs into render folder
summary: Estrarre geometry, terminal pass, selection, overlays e pane passes da `render.rs`.
description:
app-02: Split render.rs into render folder.

── Findings (verified in code 2026-10-19) ──
EFFECTIVELY DONE — candidate to close. The split happened, just under a different name: render_frame now lives in heca/src/app/frame/ (mod.rs 195 / draw.rs 132 / host_work.rs 144 / panes.rs 164), with terminal_render/ and selection.rs beside it; heca/src/app/render.rs is now a small helpers file (~150 lines). No oversized render file remains. The target-file names below (geometry.rs/terminal.rs/panes.rs/selection.rs/overlays.rs) are partly superseded by that frame/ layout; re-map the 6 tasks against frame/ before doing anything, or close.

═══ DETAIL RESCUED FROM PLAN.md (2026-07-26, before that file was deleted) ═══
Do this at the END of other work, in its own PR, never mid-feature.

ALREADY PARTLY DONE: the terminal pass was extracted to `heca/src/app/terminal_render.rs` by
PR #121 — `PaneRenderState`, `paint_terminal_pane_shell`, `render_terminal_mount`,
`selection_overlay_for_pane`. Re-scope the remainder against that before splitting further.
Target: `render_frame` shrinks toward ~250 lines.

TARGET FILES
- `mod.rs` — frame orchestrator + `update_session_viewport`
- `geometry.rs` — pane / scissor / textbox math
- `terminal.rs` — `TerminalRenderPassContext` + `render_terminal_mount`
- `panes.rs` — tiled and floating passes: blur stamps, border scenes, content
- `selection.rs` — `build_selection_overlay` / `selection_overlay_for_pane` / `status_mode_parts`
  plus their tests
- `overlays.rs` — collapsed rails, drag ghost, pane-select labels, `render_chrome` flush

EASY: geometry, terminal, selection and `render_chrome` already take explicit parameters, so those
are a mechanical move.

THE HAZARD: `panes.rs` plus the rail and ghost code live INSIDE `render_frame` and touch many
`AppState` fields while `scene_view` borrows `state.compositor`. Extract them through a
granular-field context struct — the `TerminalRenderPassContext` pattern — and NEVER through
`&mut AppState`. That borrow conflict is the whole reason this has not been done.

VERIFY BY RUNNING THE APP. GPU ordering is not unit-tested.
